I sat down with Sam Thompson again and we talked about how people overcomplicate launching a business when they should just get on the phone and start selling. Sam shared how to validate a business idea by running simple Facebook ads, jumping on sales calls, and letting real customer conversations shape your offer. He walked me through how one person went from zero to real paying clients with a Google Maps optimization service—without ever building a product first.

Then we talked about Sam’s latest ecommerce experiment, selling hummingbird nectar online, and how he’s optimizing everything from packaging to repeat orders. In the second half of the episode, we dove into how Sam is using VEO3 to create ultra-realistic AI-generated videos, video ads, and viral short-form content. He broke down his favorite prompting frameworks, why AI tools are a massive unlock for UGC-style content, and how creators and agencies can use video generation to scale faster and cheaper than ever before. If you're into content creation, AI marketing, or want to build a profitable side hustle, this one’s packed with real ideas you can use today.
